'''2013 Alderaan Regionals Bren Derlin LS Communing''' was the Light Side constructed list played by [[Bren Derlin]] at [[2013 Alderaan Regionals]] (Regionals).


== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' [[Communing (Virtual Block 7)|Communing]]
* '''Username:''' Bren Derlin
* '''Format:''' [[Legacy Open]]
* '''Stage:''' Regionals
